title: Foundation acceptance
subtitle: A reading page with interactive components

## Reading rhythm

A paragraph of ET Book prose with an [underlined achromatic link](#controls), **bold emphasis**, and `inline_code`. It keeps the quiet Tufte character while supporting readable controls and notes.[^note]

[^note]: A readable margin note should remain beside the paragraph on a wide screen and flow inline on a narrow screen.

::: {.column-margin}
A second margin note with [a link](#states), ordinary words and a short label.
:::

::: {.card}
### An unboxed group

This group has no decorative card border, fill, shadow, radius or inner padding.
:::

```python
message = "Readable code"
print(message)
```

| Variable | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Body | 20px |
| Measure | 640px |

::: {.callout-note title="Information"}
Information uses words as well as a distinguishing rule.
:::

## Controls

```{=html}
<form id="acceptance-form">
<label for="name" class="form-label">Name</label>
<input id="name" class="form-control" value="A readable field">
<label for="invalid" class="form-label">Required project</label>
<input id="invalid" class="form-control" aria-invalid="true" aria-describedby="project-error">
<p id="project-error" class="invalid-feedback">× Error: Enter a project name.</p>
<label><input id="check" class="form-check-input" type="checkbox"> Include notes</label>
<p><button id="primary" type="button" class="btn btn-primary" onclick="document.getElementById('result').textContent='✓ Action completed'">Primary action</button>
<button id="secondary" type="button" class="btn btn-secondary">Secondary action</button>
<button id="disabled" type="button" class="btn btn-primary" disabled>Unavailable</button></p>
<div role="tablist" aria-label="Reading choices">
<button id="selected" type="button" class="btn btn-secondary" role="tab" aria-selected="true" onclick="const selected=this.getAttribute('aria-selected')!=='true';this.setAttribute('aria-selected',String(selected));this.textContent=selected?'✓ Selected reading':'Select reading'">✓ Selected reading</button>
</div>
<p id="result" role="status">Ready for action.</p>
</form>
```

## States

```{=html}
<div class="alert alert-success">✓ Success: Changes saved.</div>
<div class="alert alert-warning">! Warning: Review this choice.</div>
<div class="alert alert-danger" role="alert">× Error: Correct the field above.</div>
<div class="alert alert-info">i Information: This is a new candidate state.</div>
<p><mark>Optional blue highlight with paired ink.</mark></p>
```
